utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up a few good donations already—nice to see folks pitching in. I’ll swing by later and see what else still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great to hear—I’m glad people are showing up. I’ll be there too, so we can make sure the rest gets sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll see you there—hopefully we can knock out the last bits and get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Let’s make a simple plan and keep it on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds great, Eli—thank you. I’ll map out the school schedule and send you a simple plan so we can keep everything on track.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect—once you send it, I’ll stick to the schedule and handle my part.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m in—just send me the basics for the repair drive and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll start a simple list and keep it to the essentials, so just tell me what you can bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — I can probably bring a few basic tools and some tape. Just keep me posted on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let’s start with the leaky faucet and the loose porch step—they’re the most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring a wrench for the faucet and some wood screws for the step.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is actually happening, right? I just want to confirm the details before I spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s happening. I’ll send the time and location as soon as it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll wait for your update before telling anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing and where everyone’s going to park—do we have the route and drop-off plan sorted yet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, we’ve got a rough route and drop-off spot in mind, and I’m checking the parking details now. I’ll repeat the final plan once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’d feel better once the parking and exact drop-off are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was meaning to ask if there’s anything I can help haul or fix.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — I’d really appreciate help with the heavy boxes and maybe checking the loose shelf. I’m just trying to make sure we don’t overbook anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can help with the heavy boxes and take a look at that shelf. Just point me where to start, and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on the repair supplies, Dane. Just let me know what we’re short on for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m running a bit late as usual, but I’ll check the supplies list and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush, Dane — just send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll help track down anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details first—what needs fixing and by when?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I can grab the details and check what needs fixing, then I’ll let you know the deadline.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — please send the details when you have them, and I’ll take a careful look before we do anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you remind me what changed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s still at the community center by the front desk, and the bins moved closer to the entrance. I can point you to the exact spot if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — that helps a lot. I’ll head to the front desk and look for the bins by the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. I’ve got the list sorted out and I’m just waiting on a few more items to come in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, sounds like it’s coming together. Want me to check if anyone else has extras to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who might want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure you can line up enough people for it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think so — I’ll reach out to both groups and see who can help, then I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Sam — I just need someone to help sort the donated tools and check the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll sort the tools and check the sign-up sheet now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — if you need any tools for the repair drive, I’ve got a few you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — what tools do you have, and which ones are you most comfortable lending?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill, hammer, screwdrivers, a tape measure, and a little ladder, and I’m happy to lend the hand tools and the tape measure. I usually keep the drill and ladder close, but I can talk it through if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of the repair drive details—where’s the drop-off, and what time should we be there?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Opal — the drop-off is at my place, and we should start around 10 a.m. if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works for me—I’ll be at your place by 10 a.m. and I’ll keep track of the drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the tools ready—how about we start at 10 Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 Saturday morning works for me—I’ll plan around school drop-off and be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a lot of attention already — folks are really pitching in. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping an ear out — it really helps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — if I hear any updates about drop-off times or what’s still needed, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word now — if you can help at the repair drive, I’d love to have you there. Want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, please save me a spot. I can help for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll save you a spot. Thanks for helping out; I’ll make sure you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Oren — are we still on for the repair drive this weekend, or has anything changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Mina — yes, we’re still on for the repair drive this weekend as far as I know. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — what time should I plan to be there?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey—that’s really kind. Could you help me make a quick checklist of homes to visit and note any urgent repairs?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely—I can do that. Send me the homes and I’ll note any urgent repairs too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m thinking we should bring it up at the repair drive and see who can help out. If you want, I can keep reminding folks too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, Vik — I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces, so reminders would really help. I’ll bring it up at the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep nudging people about it, and we can mention it again at the repair drive so it stays on everyone’s radar.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard folks are organizing a repair drive soon—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I haven’t caught the full details yet, but I’ve heard it’s coming together soon. I’ll let you know if I hear anything solid.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo—keep me posted if you hear more. I’m trying to follow the updates second-hand like everyone else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Sam — I’ve got the repair drive details organized, and I’m happy to help get things moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — that’s great to hear. I’m happy to pitch in however you need with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — could you help me sort the volunteer list and timing for Saturday? I’ll handle the sign-up sheet and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring my old toolbox and help where I can. Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks Uli — could you start with the loose fence panel by the side gate?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — I’ll head over there and take a look now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Noah — I’m glad you brought up the repair drive. I’m happy to help, and I can check what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Mara. I’ve got a little mixed up, so if you can check what needs doing first, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I’ll check what needs doing first and let you know what I find.
